name: Slug Generator
description: Convert any text into a clean, URL-safe slug — lowercase, hyphen- or underscore-separated, with accented characters properly transliterated instead of stripped or mangled.

faq.question: What happens to accented characters like é or ñ?
faq.answer: They're converted to their closest plain-ASCII equivalent via Unicode normalization ("café" becomes "cafe"), rather than being deleted outright (which would silently corrupt a word) or left as-is (which would break in a plain hyphen-separated URL).

faq.question: Why would I limit the max length?
faq.answer: Very long slugs are harder to read, look worse in a URL bar, and some platforms truncate them anyway — often mid-word. Setting a max length here cuts at the nearest separator boundary near that limit rather than mid-word, so you get a clean "my-blog-post" instead of a truncated "my-blog-po".
